questions.rawText: How do you maintain your physical health?
questions.questionText: How do you maintain your physical health?
questions.referenceAnswer: I maintain my physical health mainly through a balanced diet and regular exercise. I stay away from sugary drinks and fried food in daily life, and choose more fresh fruits, vegetables and lean meat. I have simple nutritious breakfast and light dinner to keep healthy eating rules. Besides, I go jogging three times a week to relax myself. These good living habits keep me energetic all day long and help me keep efficient in daily study and life.

questions.rawText: What are your nutritional habits?
questions.questionText: What are your nutritional habits?
questions.referenceAnswer: I have several healthy nutritional habits that I follow every day. I stick to regular meals and never skip breakfast. I arrange different kinds of food reasonably for three meals to take in enough nutrition. I prefer light food and stay away from greasy and high-sugar food. Meanwhile, I develop the habit of drinking enough water every day. All these good eating habits keep me energetic and maintain my physical well-being.

questions.rawText: What change do you want to make to your dietary habits in the future?
questions.questionText: What change do you want to make to your dietary habits in the future?
questions.referenceAnswer: In fact, I hope to make some positive changes to my dietary habits later on. I intend to adjust my daily diet structure and add more coarse grains and fresh vegetables to my meals. Besides, I will cut down on sweet desserts and various snacks I love. I will also pay more attention to eating meals on time and avoid staying up late for midnight snacks. These proper changes will make my eating habits healthier and help me keep in better physical condition.

questions.rawText: Do you believe mental health is equally important as physical health? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Do you believe mental health is equally important as physical health? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: Absolutely, I think mental health is just as important as physical health. Good physical health enables us to finish daily work and study smoothly. Meanwhile, positive mental health can help us ease negative emotions and deal with troubles calmly. If people only focus on physical health but ignore mental state, they will easily feel anxious and tired. Only when we value both sides can we live a steady and happy life all the time.

questions.rawText: What is your hobby?
questions.questionText: What is your hobby?
questions.referenceAnswer: My favorite hobby is reading books in my free time. I usually spend half an hour reading every evening after finishing my daily tasks. I love reading different kinds of books to know more new things. This quiet hobby can help me calm down and get away from pressure. It not only enriches my mind, but also makes my spare time meaningful and enjoyable.

questions.rawText: If you can develop a new hobby, what would it be? Why?
questions.questionText: If you can develop a new hobby, what would it be? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: If I have a chance to develop a new hobby, I would choose to learn photography. I have always been interested in recording beautiful moments in daily life. Taking photos allows me to discover more lovely scenery around me. Besides, it can help me walk out of the room and take more outdoor exercise. This hobby can not only enrich my free time, but also let me keep precious memories forever.

questions.rawText: If you fail to develop that new hobby, what could be the cause?
questions.questionText: If you fail to develop that new hobby, what could be the cause?
questions.referenceAnswer: There are several main reasons why I cannot stick to the new hobby. First of all, I may be busy with my daily study and have little spare time to practice it regularly. Besides, I often feel tired after finishing daily tasks and have no extra energy to learn new things. What’s more, I may gradually lose my initial enthusiasm and lack enough perseverance to keep going. All these situations will stop me from developing this new hobby well.

questions.rawText: Which is better, to have one big hobby or a few smaller ones? Why?
questions.questionText: Which is better, to have one big hobby or a few smaller ones? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my point of view, it is better to have a few smaller hobbies. To develop one big hobby needs lots of time and continuous efforts, which is hard to keep for busy people. However, several easy small hobbies can bring different kinds of joy. We can choose different ways to relax according to our mood and spare time. They cost less energy and greatly enrich our daily life, making free time more colorful and relaxing.

questions.rawText: Do you like watching movies? What movies do you like to watch?
questions.questionText: Do you like watching movies? What movies do you like to watch?
questions.referenceAnswer: Yes, I really enjoy watching movies in my daily free time. It is my best way to get relaxed after busy study and work. Among all kinds of movies, I like warm comedies and inspirational films best. These movies have relaxing plots and positive meanings. They can not only cheer me up when I feel upset, but also let me learn some useful life lessons easily.

questions.rawText: Do you watch movies at home or in the theatre?
questions.questionText: Do you watch movies at home or in the theatre?
questions.referenceAnswer: I mostly prefer watching movies at home in my spare time. It is really convenient and I can arrange my time freely. I can sit comfortably and eat snacks while enjoying movies. Besides, it helps me save money and avoid crowds on the way. Of course, I also admit that movies in the theatre have wonderful visual and sound effects, but staying at home suits my daily life better.

questions.rawText: Do you think that movies should still exist?
questions.questionText: Do you think that movies should still exist?
questions.referenceAnswer: Absolutely, I strongly think movies should exist forever. First of all, they are perfect daily entertainment for people to relax and release tired pressure. Besides, many wonderful movies spread traditional culture and deliver positive life values. They also allow us to experience different lives and broaden our horizons easily. There is no other way that can replace the special charm of movies in our daily life.

questions.rawText: Is watching movies a good way to communicate information or educate people?
questions.questionText: Is watching movies a good way to communicate information or educate people?
questions.referenceAnswer: Yes, I totally agree that watching movies is a great way to spread information and educate people. Many movies can deliver social facts, popularize life knowledge and share different cultural information vividly. What’s more, inspiring and meaningful movies can influence people deeply. They guide us to form good manners and right values in a relaxing way. Compared with rigid teaching, movies are more attractive and easier for people to accept and learn from.

questions.rawText: Do you celebrate holidays with your family or friends?
questions.questionText: Do you celebrate holidays with your family or friends?
questions.referenceAnswer: I usually spend most long holidays with my family. We get together at home, have big meals and chat with each other happily. It makes me feel warm and relaxed after busy days. As for short holidays or weekends, I like to go out and hang out with my friends. We can go sightseeing, taste delicious food and release pressure together. Different ways make my holiday life rich and pleasant.

questions.rawText: How often do you celebrate holidays?
questions.questionText: How often do you celebrate holidays?
questions.referenceAnswer: I celebrate holidays quite frequently. I always attach great importance to all traditional festivals and long public holidays. On these days, I will arrange time to get together and enjoy festive atmosphere. But for short one-day holidays, I just have a simple rest at home instead of holding big celebrations. In general, I cherish every holiday and make good use of them to relax myself fully.

questions.rawText: Describe one unforgettable holiday celebration.
questions.questionText: Describe one unforgettable holiday celebration.
questions.referenceAnswer: The most unforgettable holiday celebration is the Spring Festival I spent with my whole family last year. We cleaned the house together and prepared various tasty traditional food in advance. In the evening, we had a big family dinner and watched TV shows happily. We talked a lot and cared about each other’s daily life. The warm and peaceful atmosphere made me feel extremely happy. That simple but joyful festival has stayed in my mind all the time.

questions.rawText: Do you believe traditions such as holidays are still important today?
questions.questionText: Do you believe traditions such as holidays are still important today?
questions.referenceAnswer: Definitely, I think traditional holidays are still of great importance nowadays. Firstly, they are precious symbols of our traditional culture, helping us pass down old customs from generation to generation. Secondly, they provide precious time for family reunion and shorten the distance between relatives. Besides, busy modern people also need festivals to slow down and release pressure. Therefore, these fine traditions should be well preserved all the time.

questions.rawText: Describe one goal you set for yourself.
questions.questionText: Describe one goal you set for yourself.
questions.referenceAnswer: One important goal I set for myself is to keep learning new knowledge steadily. I hope I can master more practical skills within a period of time. I make simple daily plans and spare enough time to stick to it. I set this goal because I want to enrich myself and become more competitive. I believe continuous efforts will help me finally achieve this meaningful goal.

questions.rawText: How do you deal with setbacks when working towards a goal?
questions.questionText: How do you deal with setbacks when working towards a goal?
questions.referenceAnswer: When meeting setbacks while pursuing goals, I will first calm down and stop feeling discouraged. Then I will carefully think over and find out where I go wrong. I will adjust my plans and change improper ways in time. Besides, I always cheer myself up and believe temporary difficulties cannot stop me. I will sum up experience and keep moving forward towards my original goal firmly.

questions.rawText: Do you think it is important to set goals?
questions.questionText: Do you think it is important to set goals?
questions.referenceAnswer: Yes, I absolutely believe setting goals is extremely important for everyone. First of all, clear goals can give us definite directions and prevent us from feeling lost in daily life. Moreover, proper goals can greatly motivate us and push us to make continuous efforts. They also help us arrange time well and form good living habits. In short, only with goals can we live a meaningful life and achieve steady progress step by step.

questions.rawText: Do you think it is important to ask young children to set goals?
questions.questionText: Do you think it is important to ask young children to set goals?
questions.referenceAnswer: I think it is quite important to guide young children to set proper goals. Simple small goals can help them form good habits and learn to arrange things well in daily life. Also, reaching small goals can build their confidence and sense of achievement. However, these goals must be easy and suitable for their age. Too difficult aims will make them feel frustrated. Proper guidance can lay a solid foundation for their future study and growth.

questions.rawText: What kind of clothes do you prefer?
questions.questionText: What kind of clothes do you prefer?
questions.referenceAnswer: I prefer simple and comfortable casual clothes most in daily life. I love loose-cut outfits made of soft fabric, which make me feel totally relaxed. I seldom choose fashionable or fancy clothes. In my opinion, wearing comfortable clothes can help me focus more on study and work. This plain dressing style suits my personality and fits almost all daily occasions perfectly.

questions.rawText: Do you shop for clothes regularly or only rarely?
questions.questionText: Do you shop for clothes regularly or only rarely?
questions.referenceAnswer: I only shop for clothes rarely instead of doing it regularly. I hardly buy new clothes on ordinary days. I usually purchase some new outfits only when seasons change or my old clothes are not suitable to wear. I hold the view that enough clothes for daily use are totally fine. I prefer practical and durable clothes and never follow fashion trends blindly to buy too many unnecessary items.

questions.rawText: Do you spend time thinking about what to wear each day?
questions.questionText: Do you spend time thinking about what to wear each day?
questions.referenceAnswer: Actually, I seldom spend lots of time thinking about daily clothes. In ordinary working days, I always choose simple clothes casually to save morning time. I want to make full use of time instead of wasting it on dressing choices. But if I need to take part in parties or formal activities, I will spend some time matching proper outfits to look neat and suitable for the situation.

questions.rawText: Do you think it is important to follow fashion?
questions.questionText: Do you think it is important to follow fashion?
questions.referenceAnswer: I don’t think it is very important to follow fashion trends blindly. On one hand, keeping chasing new fashions costs lots of money and time. What’s worse, people may lose their own personality. On the other hand, we can learn some popular dressing ideas properly. In my opinion, wearing clothes that fit our body shape and personality is the best choice. True charm lies in personal style rather than fashionable clothes.

questions.rawText: Is technology important to you?
questions.questionText: Is technology important to you?
questions.referenceAnswer: Yes, absolutely. Modern technology is really important to me. Firstly, it greatly helps me with my study and work, making everything more efficient. Secondly, I can easily keep in touch with my family and friends anytime by using electronic devices. Besides, it also offers me many ways to relax and kill free time. In fact, I have already got used to convenient high-tech life every single day.

questions.rawText: Have you felt frustrated by technology?
questions.questionText: Have you felt frustrated by technology?
questions.referenceAnswer: Yes, I have felt frustrated by technology many times. Sometimes the internet suddenly cuts off when I am dealing with important things. Also, my phone or computer may run out of power or crash unexpectedly. These small troubles always hold me back and waste my precious time. It really makes me annoyed especially during urgent moments. Even so, I still know modern technology brings us far more advantages.

questions.rawText: Some believe technology will replace many jobs; others think it creates jobs. What’s your opinion?
questions.questionText: Some believe technology will replace many jobs; others think it creates jobs. What’s your opinion?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, both ideas are reasonable. On one side, advanced technology is replacing lots of simple repetitive jobs and manual work, which saves labor cost greatly. On the other side, it also creates numerous brand new jobs related to high-tech fields. People can work in technical research, network service and other new industries. So instead of worrying about job loss, we should keep learning and improve ourselves to keep pace with the times.

questions.rawText: Is over-reliance on technology making people lose independent thinking? What’s your opinion?
questions.questionText: Is over-reliance on technology making people lose independent thinking? What’s your opinion?
questions.referenceAnswer: I totally agree that over-reliance on technology is making people lose independent thinking. Nowadays, most people are used to searching all kinds of answers online directly instead of thinking carefully on their own. Gradually, they form thinking laziness and become unwilling to analyze problems deeply. Their own judgment and logical thinking will become weaker. Therefore, we should treat technology as a useful helper, and keep the habit of thinking independently first.

questions.rawText: What places do you commute to during the week? How?
questions.questionText: What places do you commute to during the week? How?
questions.referenceAnswer: On weekdays, I mainly commute to my working place every morning. I usually go there by subway because it is fast and can avoid traffic jams in rush hours. questions.rawText: How do you stay efficient while managing stress?

questions.rawText: Do you prefer large lectures or small group classes?

questions.rawText: What are advantages of online learning vs traditional classes?

questions.rawText: Will online learning replace traditional education completely?

questions.rawText: Some people believe online learning may replace traditional education in the future, while others disagree. What do you think? Why or why not?

questions.referenceAnswer: I have a very regular typical day and I always manage my time well. I usually get up early in the morning, finish my daily tasks first and make a simple plan for the day. In the daytime, I focus on important work or study, and set aside spare time for relaxation and exercise. In the evening, I wrap up unfinished things and leave some personal time to relax before bedtime. I organize my time by prioritizing key tasks and balancing work with rest, which makes my daily life orderly and efficient.

questions.rawText: Tell me about a time when you had to manage multiple tasks or responsibilities at once. How did you handle it?
questions.questionText: Tell me about a time when you had to manage multiple tasks or responsibilities at once. How did you handle it?
questions.referenceAnswer: I can recall a busy time when I had to deal with several tasks all at once. I needed to finish school assignments, prepare for a presentation and also take care of some personal matters within one day. To handle it well, I made a to-do list and set clear priorities for each task. I finished important and urgent things first, then dealt with the rest one by one without rushing. Finally, I got all my work done smoothly, and I learned to manage time and tasks more efficiently since then.

questions.rawText: Some people believe that managing time wisely can lead to higher productivity, while others think it can cause unnecessary stress and prefer a looser schedule. What is your opinion on this? Why?
questions.questionText: Some people believe that managing time wisely can lead to higher productivity, while others think it can cause unnecessary stress and prefer a looser schedule. What is your opinion on this? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: Wise time management improves productivity when it provides direction rather than controlling every minute. A short priority list prevents procrastination and helps people finish important work while their concentration is strong. However, an extremely detailed timetable can create anxiety and collapse when an unexpected task appears. I prefer a basic daily structure with flexible time between major tasks. This approach preserves the efficiency of planning while leaving enough space for rest and necessary changes.

questions.rawText: Can you describe a memorable visit that you or one of your friends made to a park or recreational area? What made it special?
questions.questionText: Can you describe a memorable visit that you or one of your friends made to a park or recreational area? What made it special?
questions.referenceAnswer: I’d like to talk about a memorable visit to a lakeside park with my best friend last spring. We walked along the lake, enjoyed the fresh air and beautiful natural scenery, and sat on the grass chatting for a long time. There were lovely flowers and gentle wind, and the whole atmosphere was quiet and relaxing. What made it special was that we could slow down away from busy study, enjoy each other’s company and relax completely. It left me a warm memory, and I still miss that peaceful and happy day very much.

questions.rawText: Do you think public parks and recreational spaces are more important for adults or for children? Why?
questions.questionText: Do you think public parks and recreational spaces are more important for adults or for children? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: I believe public parks are important for both adults and children, but they are more essential for kids. For children, parks are great places to run around, do physical exercise and make friends with peers. They get to enjoy nature and grow up in a healthy outdoor environment. As for adults, parks are nice for relaxing and escaping work pressure, but they have many other ways to rest. Children don’t have as many choices, so public recreational spaces are irreplaceable and much more important for them.

questions.rawText: Some people believe public parks play a crucial role in promoting community health and well-being by providing opportunities for outdoor exercise, relaxation, and social activities. questions.questionText: Some people believe public parks play a crucial role in promoting community health and well-being by providing opportunities for outdoor exercise, relaxation, and social activities. Therefore, they believe local governments should spend more resources on parks and recreational facilities. What are your thoughts on this idea? Do you agree or disagree? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: I understand the need for more housing in crowded big cities, but I still think preserving and expanding public parks is more important in the long run. It’s true that more houses can ease residential pressure and meet people’s basic living needs. However, public parks are irreplaceable for fresh air, outdoor exercise and mental relaxation. Without enough green spaces, cities will become too crowded and stressful, and people’s well-being will suffer a lot. Therefore, we should try to balance both, but never sacrifice public recreational areas just for more housing.

questions.rawText: What kinds of hobbies are especially popular today? Why?
questions.questionText: What kinds of hobbies are especially popular today? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: Nowadays, many relaxing and healthy hobbies are quite popular among people. First of all, outdoor hiking and home fitness win great popularity, since modern people pay more attention to physical health. Besides, keeping pets and quiet reading are also welcomed, which can soothe tired mood and relieve stress. What’s more, shooting short videos and doing handwork are trendy as well. People can record daily life and make like-minded friends through these hobbies. All of these activities help people enjoy a more meaningful spare time.

questions.rawText: What role do friends, family or community play in encouraging hobbies?
questions.questionText: What role do friends, family or community play in encouraging hobbies?
questions.referenceAnswer: In fact, family, friends and local communities play vital roles in inspiring us to develop hobbies. Firstly, family members always give us sincere encouragement and full support, letting us pursue what we like without worry. Secondly, friends who share the same interests can keep us company and push us to keep going. Moreover, various hobby communities offer great chances for people to exchange skills and gain new ideas. With such warm support, we are more willing to stick to our hobbies firmly.

questions.rawText: Why do many people start hobbies but not continue?
questions.questionText: Why do many people start hobbies but not continue?
questions.referenceAnswer: A large number of people begin new hobbies easily yet fail to keep them for long. First of all, they are occupied with busy work and study, leaving little free time to stick to their interests. Secondly, the initial excitement will fade away soon, and they no longer feel joyful about it. Besides, some hobbies are harder to master than they thought, so they feel frustrated and choose to give up. What’s more, lacking self-control also makes people put their hobbies aside gradually.

questions.rawText: Is spending time on hobbies essential or a luxury? What’s your opinion?
questions.questionText: Is spending time on hobbies essential or a luxury? What’s your opinion?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, spending time on hobbies is essential rather than a luxury. To begin with, modern people face great pressure from work and study, and hobbies serve as the best way to release tiredness and negative feelings. Moreover, healthy hobbies can enrich our inner life and help us develop good personal qualities. Even if we have tight schedules, we can spare a little time for interests. They bring us spiritual joy and keep us in a positive state of mind all the time.

questions.referenceAnswer: I like easy-care green plants, especially pothos and small succulents. Their leaves and shapes make a room feel fresher, but they do not require professional gardening skills. For example, I only need to water my pothos when the soil becomes dry, so it fits my busy schedule. I also prefer green plants to delicate flowers because they usually live longer indoors. Seeing them grow little by little gives me a sense of progress and makes my study space more relaxing.

questions.rawText: Some people believe gardening is a relaxing and healthy hobby, while others think it requires too much time and effort. What is your opinion?
questions.questionText: Some people believe gardening is a relaxing and healthy hobby, while others think it requires too much time and effort. What is your opinion?
questions.referenceAnswer: I believe gardening is relaxing and healthy as long as people choose plants that match their schedule. Caring for plants gives us a quiet break from screens and can reduce stress. It also involves light physical activity, such as watering, moving pots, and trimming leaves. Admittedly, a large garden can demand a lot of time, but beginners do not need to start that way. A few easy-care plants can provide the same sense of achievement without becoming a burden.

questions.rawText: Do you think schools or communities should encourage more people to learn gardening skills? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Do you think schools or communities should encourage more people to learn gardening skills? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: Yes, schools and communities should encourage basic gardening skills. First, gardening teaches responsibility because people need to water plants regularly and observe changes over time. Second, it helps students understand where food comes from and why environmental protection matters. A community could offer a small shared garden or a weekend workshop rather than requiring an expensive course. In this way, people gain practical knowledge, spend more time outdoors, and develop a stronger connection with nature.

questions.referenceAnswer: I once stayed up late preparing things and only slept for less than five hours. The next day I felt extremely tired and weak all over my body. I could not focus my attention well and my work speed became much slower. Besides, I was in a bad mood and got annoyed easily over tiny things. That bad experience taught me that enough sleep is really important for daily life.

questions.rawText: Some people believe maintaining a regular sleep schedule is essential for good health, while others think sleep patterns can be flexible as long as people get enough rest overall. What is your opinion? Why?
questions.questionText: Some people believe maintaining a regular sleep schedule is essential for good health, while others think sleep patterns can be flexible as long as people get enough rest overall. What is your opinion? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: I think keeping a regular sleep schedule is far more important for our health. Fixed rest time helps us form a steady biological clock and keep body functions balanced. Even if you sleep long enough, irregular bedtime will still make you feel tired easily. It will also affect your concentration and make you feel uncomfortable all day. We can adjust it occasionally, but regular sleeping habits are the best choice for long-term health.

questions.rawText: 4-Some people believe communities should invest more money and resources into preparing for extreme weather events. What measures do you think are the most effective? Why?
questions.questionText: Some people believe communities should invest more money and resources into preparing for extreme weather events. What measures do you think are the most effective? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: Communities should invest in early-warning systems and resilient public facilities. Accurate phone alerts can give residents enough time to avoid flooded roads, store essential supplies, or move to a safe place. At the same time, cities need better drainage, emergency shelters, and backup power for hospitals. Public education is also important, because infrastructure is less useful if people do not know how to respond. These measures combine prevention, quick communication, and practical protection, so they can reduce both injuries and property damage.

They also satisfy people’s need for hanging out and social activities, so they will always be important.

questions.rawText: What do you think are the main reasons people use social media today?

questions.questionText: 4.Some people believe social media helps people stay connected and maintain relationships, while others think it reduces face-to-face communication. What is your opinion? Why?

We can keep our relationships steady no matter how far we are apart. However, many people prefer online chats and seldom meet others in real life. Real eye contact and sincere talks are far warmer than simple online messages.

questions.rawText: What is one aspect of history that you find particularly interesting?
questions.questionText: What is one aspect of history that you find particularly interesting?
questions.referenceAnswer: Personally, the aspect of ancient civilizations and traditional cultural history interests me the most. Specifically, I am fascinated by various historical anecdotes and the development of ancient cultures. First of all, these vivid historical stories are far more immersive and impressive than textbook knowledge. They record how ancient people lived, created and explored the world. Besides, ancient history accumulates profound wisdom and valuable experience. It inspires modern society and helps us better understand our cultural roots. That’s why I regard traditional historical civilization as the most attractive part of history.

questions.rawText: Describe a history-related activity or project you enjoyed, and explain what made it engaging.
questions.questionText: Describe a history-related activity or project you enjoyed, and explain what made it engaging.

During the activity, our school displayed various cultural relic models, historical pictures and restored ancient life scenes. We also shared interesting historical stories in groups. What made it so engaging was its vivid presentation. It turned those abstract textbook knowledge into visual and touching scenes, which was far less boring than rote learning. Moreover, the immersive experience deepened my understanding of history. That’s why this simple activity left a deep impression on me.

questions.rawText: If you were to visit a historical site you’ve never visited before, which one would you choose and why?
questions.questionText: If you were to visit a historical site you’ve never visited before, which one would you choose and why?
questions.referenceAnswer: Without hesitation, I would choose to visit the Palace Museum, which is one of the most famous historical sites in China. To begin with, it boasts magnificent imperial architectural complexes with traditional layouts and delicate designs. Standing inside allows me to intuitively appreciate ancient royal aesthetics and traditional construction wisdom. Furthermore, it houses countless precious historical artifacts. These well-preserved cultural relics vividly record historical changes and help me understand ancient history more concretely. That’s why this historical site is my top choice for a future visit.

questions.rawText: Do you think the study of history remains important in today’s educational system? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Do you think the study of history remains important in today’s educational system? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: Absolutely, I firmly believe that learning history is still extremely important in today’s educational system. To start with, history helps students shape independent thinking and correct personal values. By learning historical events, we can draw lessons from the past and avoid making similar mistakes in real life, which greatly improves our critical thinking. Furthermore, historical study plays a key role in cultural inheritance. Different from trendy modern knowledge, history provides long-term and profound guiding value for both individuals and society, so it is irreplaceable in modern education.

questions.rawText: In your opinion, how important is goal setting for personal growth?

This good habit lays a solid foundation for their long-term personal development.

Therefore, cities should prioritize housing construction.

questions.questionText: 2:Can you describe what measures your community or neighborhood has taken for environmental protection?

questions.rawText: 4：Some people believe individual actions are insufficient to solve environmental problems, and major changes must come from government policies. Do you agree or disagree?
questions.questionText: 4:Some people believe individual actions are insufficient to solve environmental problems, and major changes must come from government policies. Do you agree or disagree?

If the warning mentions a severe storm, I move unnecessary appointments online. These small preparations protect my belongings and prevent a predictable weather problem from disrupting the entire day.

questions.rawText: If you were to choose a place to live, would you prefer consistent weather throughout the whole year or distinct seasons? Why do you have this preference?
questions.questionText: If you were to choose a place to live, would you prefer consistent weather throughout the whole year or distinct seasons? Why do you have this preference?
questions.referenceAnswer: I would choose a place with distinct seasons. Seasonal change keeps daily life from feeling repetitive: spring is suitable for walks, summer for evening activities, autumn for travel, and winter for quiet indoor time. It also makes annual traditions feel more meaningful. A stable mild climate would be convenient, but I would miss the visual changes and different rhythms that four seasons bring.

questions.rawText: If you had more free time, what outdoor activities would you like to do?
questions.questionText: If you had more free time, what outdoor activities would you like to do?
questions.referenceAnswer: If I had more free time, I would go hiking on easy mountain trails. Hiking would take me away from screens, give me steady exercise, and let me explore scenery that I cannot experience indoors. I would start with a half-day route and go with one or two friends for safety. Taking photos at a few viewpoints would also preserve the memory. It would be a practical combination of exercise, nature, and social time.

questions.rawText: How do you feel differently when you spend time outdoors compared to indoors?
questions.questionText: How do you feel differently when you spend time outdoors compared to indoors?
questions.referenceAnswer: I feel noticeably calmer and more alert outdoors. Indoors, especially after several hours at a desk, my thoughts become repetitive and my body feels stiff. A walk in fresh air gives me changing sights and light exercise, so my attention resets naturally. I also become less tempted to check messages constantly. By the time I return home, I usually have more energy and can concentrate better than before the walk.

questions.rawText: Do you think lack of exposure to nature affects people's health? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Do you think lack of exposure to nature affects people's health? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: Yes. Limited contact with nature can affect both physical and mental health. People who remain indoors tend to move less, receive less sunlight, and spend more time looking at screens. That routine may contribute to poor sleep, low energy, and stress. Nature is not a complete medical solution, but regular access to a park or tree-lined walking route makes exercise and emotional recovery easier. Even a short outdoor break can improve a person's daily routine.

questions.rawText: Should outdoor attractions or facilities be free or require payment? What is your opinion?
questions.questionText: Should outdoor attractions or facilities be free or require payment? What is your opinion?
questions.referenceAnswer: I think basic outdoor attractions should be free, while special services can charge a reasonable fee. Free access to parks and walking trails gives everyone, including low-income families, a place to exercise and relax. However, facilities such as cable cars, equipment rental, or guided tours cost money to operate and maintain. Charging only for those optional services creates a fair balance. The public keeps access to nature, and managers still receive enough funding to protect the site and keep it safe.

questions.rawText: Do you play a musical instrument or sing?
questions.questionText: Do you play a musical instrument or sing?
questions.referenceAnswer: I do not currently play an instrument well, but I can sing simple songs and I would like to learn the keyboard. A keyboard is practical because I can use headphones and practice without disturbing other people. It would also help me understand rhythm and melody instead of only listening passively. I would begin with fifteen-minute lessons several times a week. Even if I never perform publicly, learning a few complete songs would be a relaxing and satisfying personal goal.

questions.rawText: Describe an unforgettable music experience you have had.
questions.questionText: Describe an unforgettable music experience you have had.
questions.referenceAnswer: An unforgettable music experience for me was a small outdoor performance beside a lake. The audience sat on the grass while two musicians played acoustic songs at sunset. There were no elaborate lights or special effects, but the natural setting made the sound feel warm and immediate. I remember it because everyone listened quietly and shared the same peaceful mood. It showed me that a simple live performance can create a stronger connection than a polished online recording.

questions.rawText: Do you prefer listening to music alone or with others? Why?
questions.questionText: Do you prefer listening to music alone or with others? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: I usually prefer listening to music alone. When I study, walk, or commute, headphones let me choose exactly what fits my mood and become absorbed in the melody without having to talk. This makes music an effective way to calm down and recharge. I still enjoy sharing songs with friends or attending a live show together, because music can create a social connection. However, for everyday listening, being alone gives me more freedom and a deeper sense of immersion.

questions.rawText: Do you think music classes should be mandatory in schools? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Do you think music classes should be mandatory in schools? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: Music classes should be available to every student, but advanced performance should not be mandatory. Basic lessons in rhythm, singing, or simple instruments develop creativity and give students a healthy way to express emotion. Group practice can also teach listening and cooperation. However, students have different interests, so schools should not judge everyone by difficult technical exams. A broad introductory course provides the educational benefits without creating unnecessary pressure.

questions.rawText: Do you currently live with others or on your own?
questions.questionText: Do you currently live with others or on your own?
questions.referenceAnswer: I currently live with my family rather than on my own. Sharing a home is convenient because we divide routine tasks such as cooking, shopping, and cleaning. It also means that I have someone to talk to after a busy day, which makes the home feel warmer. Of course, living together requires communication, especially when our schedules are different. We try to respect one another's quiet time and take responsibility for our own rooms, so the arrangement works well.

questions.rawText: Aside from sleeping, what do you currently spend most time doing at home? For example, preparing for school or work, doing household work, or tasks such as cooking or cleaning?
questions.questionText: Aside from sleeping, what do you currently spend most time doing at home? For example, preparing for school or work, doing household work, or tasks such as cooking or cleaning?
questions.referenceAnswer: Aside from sleeping, I spend most of my time at home studying and preparing for work. I usually read course materials, organize notes, and complete tasks at my desk for two or three hours in the evening. I take short breaks to stretch or help with simple chores, because sitting continuously makes me less efficient. This routine may sound ordinary, but a quiet home environment allows me to focus and finish important work before I relax.

questions.rawText: What is one regular household task you don't enjoy, and why is this particular task not enjoyable?
questions.questionText: What is one regular household task you don't enjoy, and why is this particular task not enjoyable?
questions.referenceAnswer: The household task I dislike most is cleaning the bathroom. It is repetitive, involves wet surfaces, and takes longer than it first appears because the sink, mirror, floor, and shower all need different kinds of attention. I also dislike the strong smell of some cleaning products. To make it easier, I clean small areas regularly instead of waiting for dirt to build up, and I use milder products. Even so, it is still the chore I least look forward to.

questions.rawText: What household invention that makes chores easier would be difficult to live without? Why?
questions.questionText: What household invention that makes chores easier would be difficult to live without? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: A washing machine would be the hardest household invention for me to live without. Washing clothes by hand takes a great deal of time and physical effort, especially for heavy items such as towels and bedding. A machine lets me start a load and use that time for studying, cooking, or another chore. It also provides consistent cleaning and spinning, so clothes dry faster. For a busy household, it is not just convenient; it makes the entire weekly routine manageable.

questions.rawText: Do you prefer indoor or outdoor leisure activities in your free time?
questions.questionText: Do you prefer indoor or outdoor leisure activities in your free time?
questions.referenceAnswer: I prefer outdoor leisure activities when the weather is comfortable. After spending much of the day indoors and looking at screens, walking in a park gives my eyes and mind a real break. Fresh air and light movement also improve my mood more effectively than scrolling on my phone. Indoor activities are useful on rainy days, and I enjoy reading at home. Still, if I have a free afternoon, I would rather go outside because it combines relaxation with gentle exercise.

questions.rawText: What is your favorite leisure activity?
questions.questionText: What is your favorite leisure activity?
questions.referenceAnswer: My favorite leisure activity is taking a long walk while listening to music. It requires almost no preparation, so I can do it whenever I have thirty minutes free. The movement helps release physical tension, while soft music keeps my mind from returning to work or study problems. I often choose a quiet route near a park and put my phone away except for the music. Afterward, I usually feel calmer, more energetic, and ready to focus again.

questions.rawText: Do you prefer sticking to familiar hobbies or trying new activities? Why?
questions.questionText: Do you prefer sticking to familiar hobbies or trying new activities? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: I prefer a balance, but I try new activities from time to time. Familiar hobbies are reliable: I already have the skills and can relax immediately. However, a new activity can prevent my free time from becoming repetitive and may reveal an interest I did not know I had. For example, I once joined a beginner photography walk and started noticing details in my neighborhood. I would keep one or two familiar hobbies and occasionally add a low-pressure new experience.

questions.rawText: Do you think leisure activities are important for people's mental health? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Do you think leisure activities are important for people's mental health? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: Yes, leisure activities are essential for mental health rather than a luxury. They give people a clear break from academic or work pressure and reduce the risk of burnout. Hobbies can also create small achievements that are unrelated to grades or job performance. For example, finishing a book or learning a song can restore confidence after a stressful day. Leisure should not take over all our responsibilities, but regular, limited downtime helps us return to those responsibilities with better concentration and emotional balance.

questions.rawText: How do you usually schedule your day?
questions.questionText: How do you usually schedule your day?
questions.referenceAnswer: I tend to strictly organize my daily schedule to keep a balanced lifestyle. Early in the morning, I devote most of my energy to core academic work when my mind is the sharpest. After finishing classes, I reserve a period for outdoor exercise to release pressure. At night, I slow down my pace by reading light books instead of scrolling phones. This well-planned routine allows me to maximize study efficiency while leaving enough time for relaxation.

questions.rawText: Do you make daily plans?
questions.questionText: Do you make daily plans?
questions.referenceAnswer: Yes, I make a short plan every morning. I list three essential tasks instead of filling every hour, because an overloaded schedule becomes stressful and unrealistic. I normally complete the hardest task when my concentration is strongest and leave a flexible period for unexpected work. In the evening, I check what remains and move only necessary items to the next day. This simple habit gives me direction without making the day feel rigid.

questions.rawText: What would you do if your day didn't go according to the plan?
questions.questionText: What would you do if your day didn't go according to the plan?
questions.referenceAnswer: If my whole schedule fell apart, I would remain calm and reset my timetable right away. To start with, I would sort out all tasks by priority and cross out trivial items to reduce pressure. Afterwards, I would squeeze spare time after dinner to make up for unfinished assignments. Rather than wasting time complaining about unexpected changes, I focus on flexible adjustment, which helps me regain control of my daily rhythm.

questions.rawText: Do you think that good daily planning can affect the efficiency of work or study?
questions.questionText: Do you think that good daily planning can affect the efficiency of work or study?
questions.referenceAnswer: I firmly believe scientific daily scheduling exerts a decisive impact on academic and work productivity. For one thing, a well-designed to-do list helps people rank tasks by importance and make full use of peak mental hours, greatly cutting down unnecessary delays. In contrast, people without fixed plans tend to jump randomly between jobs, get easily distracted and end up with unfinished work. Therefore, effective daily planning is an essential tool to maintain stable high efficiency.

questions.rawText: Do you often go shopping? If you do, what is your shopping frequency like?
questions.questionText: Do you often go shopping? If you do, what is your shopping frequency like?
questions.referenceAnswer: Actually, I hardly ever go out shopping. I only head to supermarkets or stores twice a month to stock up on necessities. I prefer online orders for most items to save time, so I limit offline shopping to a fixed monthly schedule. This moderate shopping rhythm helps me manage my budget well and prevents me from making impulse purchases.

questions.rawText: What will you buy when you go shopping? If you do go shopping, will you make a plan in advance?
questions.questionText: What will you buy when you go shopping? If you do go shopping, will you make a plan in advance?
questions.referenceAnswer: When I head out for shopping, my cart is usually filled with groceries and basic daily supplies. Occasionally I will look for casual clothes if I have extra budget. Speaking of pre-shopping plans, I always prepare a detailed shopping list in advance. It effectively prevents unnecessary impulse buying and ensures I only purchase items I truly need, which is a great way to manage my monthly expenses.

questions.rawText: Do you tend to make impulsive purchases? If you do, what kind of things might you buy?
questions.questionText: Do you tend to make impulsive purchases? If you do, what kind of things might you buy?
questions.referenceAnswer: I barely engage in impulsive shopping most of the time. Before paying for anything, I will check my shopping list and judge whether the item is necessary. The only products that may tempt me are handmade snacks. But I will pause and think twice instead of buying them without planning. This self-control helps me keep a reasonable monthly budget and avoid unnecessary waste.

questions.rawText: Do you prefer to shop locally or at large supermarkets?
questions.questionText: Do you prefer to shop locally or at large supermarkets?
questions.referenceAnswer: I prefer large supermarkets for planned weekly shopping. They offer groceries, household supplies, and personal-care products in one place, so I save time and can compare prices easily. The wider selection also makes it easier to stay within a budget. However, I still use local shops for fresh food or an urgent purchase because they are close and provide more personal service. Overall, supermarkets are more efficient for a large list, while neighborhood stores are better for small immediate needs.

questions.rawText: Did you enjoy going to school when you were a child?
questions.questionText: Did you enjoy going to school when you were a child?
questions.referenceAnswer: Absolutely, I cherished my school days in my childhood. I got along closely with my peers, and we took part in various group activities after class. My teachers always used vivid ways to deliver lessons instead of rigid teaching. Although there were occasional assignments to finish, the lively campus atmosphere far outweighed small pressures. Those joyful memories still leave a warm impression on me.

questions.rawText: Tell me about a school project or activity that you participated in. What made this project or activity special?
questions.questionText: Tell me about a school project or activity that you participated in. What made this project or activity special?
questions.referenceAnswer: One memorable school activity I joined was a group research project about local traditional culture last semester. My teammates and I interviewed elderly residents and sorted out lots of cultural materials together. What rendered this project unique was that it offered me a precious chance to communicate with seniors and dig into local history. Apart from new knowledge, I also mastered how to divide tasks reasonably within a team, which is a valuable skill I still use today.

questions.rawText: Tell me about a skill you learned during your childhood education. Do you think this skill has prepared you for your life after school? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Tell me about a skill you learned during your childhood education. Do you think this skill has prepared you for your life after school? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: One vital skill I acquired in my childhood schooling is the ability to cooperate with teammates. During group class projects, my instructor guided us to split tasks and communicate patiently. I firmly hold that this competence perfectly prepares me for post-school life. In future study and daily work, I will constantly need to collaborate with different people. This early training enables me to solve group conflicts efficiently and achieve shared goals smoothly, which is irreplaceable for adult life.

questions.rawText: Some people believe that the current education system needs significant reform to better prepare children for their future, focusing more on skills such as problem-solving and teamwork. Do you agree or disagree with this view?
questions.questionText: Some people believe that the current education system needs significant reform to better prepare children for their future, focusing more on skills such as problem-solving and teamwork. Do you agree or disagree with this view?
questions.referenceAnswer: I fully agree that today’s education system needs big changes to focus more on teamwork and problem-solving skills. At present, most classes only focus on textbook knowledge and exams, giving students little chance to practice practical abilities. If schools reform their courses, kids can learn to solve troubles and cooperate with partners. These two skills are very useful for their future work and daily life. Of course basic subjects are still important, but more practical training is necessary for children’s long-term development.

questions.rawText: What kind of movies do your family members or friends usually enjoy watching? For instance, do they prefer action movies, comedies, dramas or other types of films?
questions.questionText: What kind of movies do your family members or friends usually enjoy watching? For instance, do they prefer action movies, comedies, dramas or other types of films?
questions.referenceAnswer: There is a clear difference in movie preferences between my family members and my peers. My parents are fond of realistic life dramas and educational documentaries, which carry thoughtful themes about society. Meanwhile, my friends and I are huge fans of light comedies and action blockbusters with thrilling scenes. These entertaining films serve as perfect stress relievers. Unlike slow, serious dramas favored by the elders, fast-paced funny stories fit young people’s leisure needs better.

questions.rawText: When watching a movie, do you prefer to do it after school on a weekday or after school on a weekend? Why?
questions.questionText: When watching a movie, do you prefer to do it after school on a weekday or after school on a weekend? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: Without hesitation, I choose to watch movies in my spare time after school on weekends. Weekdays are packed with endless coursework and take-home assignments, leaving me merely a short window for rest. A full-length film would cut my sleeping hours and hurt my learning efficiency the following day. By contrast, weekends free me from academic pressure. I can fully immerse myself in movies and unwind without any urgent tasks hanging over me.

questions.rawText: In the past, most people went to the cinema to watch movies. Nowadays, many people watch movies at home. Do you think cinemas will continue to exist in the future? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: In the past, most people went to the cinema to watch movies. Nowadays, many people watch movies at home. Do you think cinemas will continue to exist in the future? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: In the past, almost everyone watched films in cinemas, but now most people prefer watching movies at home. I believe cinemas will still exist far into the future. First, cinemas provide huge screens and great sound, which we cannot get at home. Besides, going to the cinema is a popular social activity for friends and lovers. Although watching movies at home saves money and time, it can’t bring that special immersive feeling. So cinemas will never disappear.

questions.rawText: Where do you mainly get your history knowledge, from school or outside classes?
questions.questionText: Where do you mainly get your history knowledge, from school or outside classes?
questions.referenceAnswer: Although school provides basic historical theories, I gain most of my historical knowledge through out-of-class resources. I regularly watch well-made historical documentaries and read biographies of ancient figures. These materials deliver vivid, detailed stories that textbooks cannot cover. Classroom learning only lays a basic foundation, and extracurricular resources greatly enrich my understanding of history.

questions.rawText: What part of history do you find the most interesting when learning it?
questions.questionText: What part of history do you find the most interesting when learning it?
questions.referenceAnswer: I find the history of technological change most interesting. Inventions such as printing, railways, and the internet did more than introduce new machines; they changed how ordinary people learned, worked, and communicated. I enjoy tracing one invention from its original purpose to its wider social effects. This approach connects scientific progress with daily life and helps me understand why societies sometimes change rapidly. It makes history feel like a chain of human decisions rather than a list of dates.

questions.rawText: 3.Have you visited any historical sites or museums? Did it deepen your understanding of history?
questions.questionText: 3.Have you visited any historical sites or museums? Did it deepen your understanding of history?
questions.referenceAnswer: I have toured several historical museums and ancient architectural sites during my holidays. Those sites display genuine cultural relics and well-preserved ancient buildings, which serve as tangible evidence of past eras. Undoubtedly, these visits greatly deepened my comprehension of history. Unlike abstract textbook records, real exhibits help me grasp the complete historical context and build a more vivid, three-dimensional view of ancient civilizations.

questions.rawText: Some people believe learning history can stop people from repeating past mistakes. Do you agree?
questions.questionText: Some people believe learning history can stop people from repeating past mistakes. Do you agree?
questions.referenceAnswer: In my view, studying history effectively helps humans draw valuable lessons and lower the risk of repeating past errors, yet it cannot completely eliminate such mistakes. For one thing, records of historical tragedies act as lasting warnings, enabling people to recognize risky decisions in advance. Nevertheless, short-sighted self-interest and the forgetting of historical facts often lead people to repeat similar faults. Therefore, continuous history education is essential, though it only works as a reminder rather than a perfect solution.

questions.rawText: Do you think exercising every day is important for health? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Do you think exercising every day is important for health? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: I firmly hold the view that daily moderate exercise plays an irreplaceable role in maintaining physical and mental well-being. For one thing, consistent workouts accelerate metabolism and strengthen immune functions, lowering risks of chronic illnesses. Furthermore, physical activity triggers the release of happy chemicals to ease anxiety and raise daily concentration. Nevertheless, excessive high-intensity exercise may lead to exhaustion instead of better health. Thus, light daily movement is highly recommended for everyone.

questions.rawText: If you designed an exercise plan for friends or family who rarely work out, what would it include?
questions.questionText: If you designed an exercise plan for friends or family who rarely work out, what would it include?
questions.referenceAnswer: I would design a gradual plan that beginners could maintain. During the first two weeks, they would take a fifteen-minute brisk walk five days a week. Then I would add two short strength sessions using safe movements such as wall push-ups, squats to a chair, and gentle stretching. Rest days would remain flexible, and we would record progress rather than focus on weight. Starting with manageable tasks would reduce soreness, build confidence, and make regular exercise feel achievable.

questions.rawText: What is the biggest challenge they face when sticking to regular exercise? How can you help them?
questions.questionText: What is the biggest challenge they face when sticking to regular exercise? How can you help them?
questions.referenceAnswer: For those who seldom work out, the primary barrier to consistent exercise lies in insufficient self-motivation. Tiredness from daily chores and mild muscle discomfort after light training together make them inclined to give up halfway. To tackle this trouble, I will accompany them to finish daily workouts regularly. Mutual supervision pushes them to stick to schedules. Moreover, I will design simple target rewards to offer positive encouragement. Such support effectively fights their mental laziness and helps them form long-term fitness routines.

questions.rawText: Some people think people should get rewards after a week of exercise. What rewards do you think work well?
questions.questionText: Some people think people should get rewards after a week of exercise. What rewards do you think work well?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, weekly rewards serve as powerful positive motivation for fitness beginners, and two types stand out the most. For one thing, affordable fitness-related treats are ideal, such as light desserts or portable workout gear. They satisfy desires moderately without offsetting weekly exercise gains. For another, leisure as a mental reward is equally valuable. Extra free time for entertainment effectively relieves physical and mental exhaustion brought by regular training. Combining small material treats and relaxing leisure perfectly maintains people’s long-term enthusiasm for working out.

questions.rawText: Do you like giving gifts to others? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Do you like giving gifts to others? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: Personally, I really enjoy preparing gifts for my family and friends. First of all, a carefully chosen gift is a great way to show my care and love. Words sometimes feel plain, but presents can express my sincere feelings directly. Besides, I get huge satisfaction when I see them light up and smile after receiving my gifts. This warm reaction makes all my time picking gifts worthwhile. All in all, giving gifts helps me maintain close relationships with people I care about.

questions.rawText: How do you decide what gift to buy? What factors do you take into consideration?
questions.questionText: How do you decide what gift to buy? What factors do you take into consideration?
questions.referenceAnswer: When selecting presents for others, I weigh several standards thoroughly, among which two factors stand out. For one thing, I prioritize recipients’ hobbies and practical demands. A present catering to their daily lives can fully deliver my thoughtfulness rather than becoming useless decoration. For another, I always keep my budget in mind to avoid unnecessary financial pressure. Reasonable spending matters more than costly goods. Overall, balancing receivers’ needs and my financial limit allows me to select ideal gifts.

questions.rawText: Do you prefer wish list gifts or surprise gifts? Why?
questions.questionText: Do you prefer wish list gifts or surprise gifts? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, I hold a stronger preference for wish-list gifts rather than surprise presents. For one thing, items written on wish lists perfectly cater to recipients’ genuine demands, which prevents presents from being left unused. For another, a clear wish list frees me from the stress of guessing personal preferences and lowers the risk of disappointing others. Admittedly, surprise gifts bring unexpected joy, yet they lack practicality most of the time. In short, wish-list gifts balance thoughtfulness and practicality best.

questions.rawText: Do you usually go to bed early or late?
questions.questionText: Do you usually go to bed early or late?
questions.referenceAnswer: In daily life, I maintain an early bedtime habit and rarely stay up past eleven o’clock. For one thing, adequate sleep from early rest sustains my energy throughout the whole day, preventing me from getting distracted during study. Furthermore, this healthy schedule stabilizes my mental state and greatly boosts my learning efficiency. Although occasional heavy tasks force me to sleep late, I still prioritize regular rest as much as possible. In short, an early bedtime creates a balanced and productive lifestyle for me.

questions.rawText: What do you usually do before going to sleep?
questions.questionText: What do you usually do before going to sleep?
questions.referenceAnswer: Normally, I follow two relaxing routines before bedtime. To start with, I do five minutes of gentle stretching to release muscle tension from long hours of studying. It eases my body tiredness a lot. After that, I listen to soft instrumental music instead of scrolling phones. Loud videos would excite my brain and stop me from falling asleep quickly. In this way, my body and mind both slow down step by step, so I can enjoy a deep and peaceful sleep every night.

questions.rawText: Can you sleep well in unfamiliar places such as hotels or other people’s houses? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Can you sleep well in unfamiliar places such as hotels or other people’s houses? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: To be frank, I rarely enjoy sound sleep when staying in hotels or others’ residences. For one thing, unfamiliar surroundings trigger subconscious alertness, making it tough for my mind to fully unwind before rest. Furthermore, inconsistent bedding, stray noises and strange lighting disrupt my fixed sleep routine, frequently waking me at midnight. In short, without the familiar atmosphere of my own bedroom, I can barely get high-quality rest.

questions.rawText: Do you think schools should delay class start time to let students get more sleep? Why?
questions.questionText: Do you think schools should delay class start time to let students get more sleep? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: I firmly believe schools should postpone morning classes to guarantee students sufficient sleep. For one thing, adequate rest eliminates constant drowsiness in the early morning, significantly raising students’ focus and academic efficiency in class. For another, sufficient sleep is vital for adolescent development; persistent sleep deprivation impairs memory and triggers unstable emotions. Admittedly, this policy shortens spare time after school, yet its long-term advantages for study and well-being outweigh minor drawbacks. Overall, adjusting class hours is a wise choice for young students.

questions.rawText: Do you take part in art activities in daily life? What type of art would you like to try?
questions.questionText: Do you take part in art activities in daily life? What type of art would you like to try?
questions.referenceAnswer: In daily routines, I engage in lightweight artistic pastimes such as casual sketching and browsing art exhibition content online. If given a chance, pottery creation is the art form I am eager to experience most. For one thing, manipulating soft clay serves as an effective way to ease accumulated academic stress and soothe anxious thoughts. For another, it allows me to craft exclusive hand-made ornaments full of personal characteristics. In short, this art combines relaxation and creativity, making it well worth a try.

questions.rawText: What kind of art or music do you like most? Do you prefer creating works or simply appreciating them?
questions.questionText: What kind of art or music do you like most? Do you prefer creating works or simply appreciating them?
questions.referenceAnswer: Soft instrumental pieces rank as my favorite form of artistic expression, whose mild melodies effectively ease my daily anxiety. When it comes to creating versus appreciating artworks, I lean strongly toward appreciation. For one thing, enjoying ready-made art requires no extra equipment or skills, allowing me to absorb its beauty at any spare moment. For another, artistic creation calls for persistent professional training and plenty of energy, adding extra pressure to my busy schedule. In short, pure appreciation brings me relaxing comfort without any trouble.

questions.rawText: After finishing an artwork, will you share it publicly or keep it to yourself?
questions.questionText: After finishing an artwork, will you share it publicly or keep it to yourself?
questions.referenceAnswer: Once I finish an artistic piece, I tend to post and share it with others openly. For one thing, audiences provide constructive comments that point out my flaws, constantly promoting my artistic progress. Furthermore, displaying creations enables me to bond with fellow art enthusiasts and exchange unique creative inspirations. Admittedly, private storage keeps my inner thoughts undisturbed, but the growth brought by sharing is irreplaceable. In short, I value the improvement and communication from public display.

questions.rawText: Do you think art and music can express feelings and thoughts better than language?
questions.questionText: Do you think art and music can express feelings and thoughts better than language?
questions.referenceAnswer: I hold the view that art and music outperform verbal language in conveying subtle sentiments, yet neither side can completely replace the other. For one thing, indescribable inner moods can be vividly conveyed through tunes and visual art, creating wordless resonance that breaks linguistic boundaries. On the other hand, complicated logical viewpoints require precise language to clarify, which vague artistic expression fails to achieve. In short, art and music are superior for emotional output, whereas language dominates delivering rational thoughts.

questions.rawText: Describe an unforgettable experience you had in a park or other leisure public space.
questions.questionText: Describe an unforgettable experience you had in a park or other leisure public space.
questions.referenceAnswer: One memory that remains striking to me occurred in an urban lakeside park last summer, when I hung out with my closest companion. We prepared light food for a lawn picnic. Towards dusk, a street folk singer performed gentle melodies beside the lake, accompanied by gorgeous golden sunset scenery. What renders this experience irreplaceable is the complete relief from persistent academic pressure and warm time shared with my friend. Even today, the tranquil vibe of that afternoon still lingers in my thoughts.

questions.rawText: Are parks more important for adults or children?
questions.questionText: Are parks more important for adults or children?
questions.referenceAnswer: I firmly believe parks carry greater significance for children rather than adult groups. For one thing, confined indoor spaces limit youngsters’ activities, while parks supply wide open areas for outdoor workouts and access to natural scenery, benefiting their physical growth. By contrast, adults own diverse leisure substitutes to ease work tension, so parks are merely an optional choice for them. Admittedly, green parks relieve adults’ anxiety, yet they act as an irreplaceable place for kids to socialize with peers. In short, parks are much more critical to children’s growth.

questions.questionText: Should governments invest more money in building public parks?

For another, free public green spaces offer accessible entertainment for all age groups, catering to children’s outdoor activities and adults’ stress relief. Admittedly, public medical and educational facilities also demand funding, but parks generate enduring public welfare worth extra investment.

questions.questionText: Some people believe shopping in physical stores is more convenient, while others think online shopping is a worse experience because it lacks the human interaction of in-person shopping. What is your opinion, and why?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, online shopping provides a better overall experience, and the lack of human interaction is only a negligible shortcoming. To begin with, it boasts unmatched convenience. It allows me to skip tiring commutes and tedious waiting lines in physical stores, finishing price comparison and purchases anytime at home. Furthermore, most daily commodities are standard and simple to select. Timely online customer consultation perfectly makes up for the lack of face-to-face interaction. Admittedly, in-store shopping offers intuitive product experience, but for regular daily purchases, efficiency always takes priority. Overall, online shopping suits my lifestyle much better.

Customers can try on clothes, test electronic devices and check product quality on the spot, which perfectly avoids inconsistent goods description and delivery risks of online shopping. Moreover, physical stores allow instant acquisition of goods, which satisfies people’s urgent demands. Admittedly, ordinary shops may face fierce competition, but experience-based and service-oriented stores are always needed. In conclusion, online and offline shopping coexist well instead of replacing each other.

questions.questionText: How often do you listen to music? Do you listen daily, weekly, or less often?
questions.referenceAnswer: Personally, I mainly enjoy listening to light classical music and soft pop music in my daily life. Specifically, light classical music has gentle rhythms and pure melodies without lyrics. It can calm my mind effectively and help me regain focus when I feel distracted. Besides, soft pop songs are quite soothing and relaxing. Their mild tunes perfectly ease my emotional stress after busy study or work. Unlike rock or jazz, these two genres are peaceful and suitable for my daily relaxation all the time.

questions.rawText: What genres or types of music do you usually enjoy listening to, such as classical, rock or jazz?
questions.questionText: What genres or types of music do you usually enjoy listening to, such as classical, rock or jazz?
questions.referenceAnswer: Honestly, I have always wanted to attend a live pop music concert in the future. Primarily, a live concert offers a totally immersive musical atmosphere that recorded music cannot compare with. The vivid melody and on-site rhythm are extremely touching and inspiring. Moreover, attending a live event allows me to interact with fellow music lovers and resonate with the singer’s performance. This kind of passionate crowd atmosphere can fully release my accumulated stress. Therefore, I’m eager to join a wonderful live music concert for relaxation and spiritual enjoyment.

questions.questionText: Can you talk about a concert or live music event you would like to attend, and explain your reasons?
questions.referenceAnswer: Absolutely, I fully agree that music exerts a powerful and positive influence on people’s emotions and moods. To start with, soft and slow music can effectively relieve negative feelings like anxiety and exhaustion. It helps people calm down and regain peace of mind after stressful study or work. Besides, upbeat music with fast rhythms can instantly lift people’s spirits, boost energy and improve overall motivation. It turns a dull mood into a positive one in a very short time. Therefore, music acts as a natural emotional regulator and greatly shapes our daily moods.
