Apart from that, social media serves as a convenient communication tool for me. I can stay connected with my friends and family through messages and posts. Overall, I use social media as an efficient information and social tool instead of indulging in endless entertainment.

questions.rawText: In your opinion, what parts of social media are enjoyable, and what parts are troublesome?
questions.questionText: In your opinion, what parts of social media are enjoyable, and what parts are troublesome?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, social media has both enjoyable aspects and troublesome drawbacks. On the bright side, it offers abundant diverse content including short videos and articles. It perfectly enriches my spare time, broadens my horizons and relieves daily study or work pressure. On the downside, it brings obvious troubles. It is flooded with fragmented information and misleading fake news. Worse still, endless feeds easily distract people’s attention and reduce personal efficiency. Overall, social media is a double-edged sword, so we need to use it rationally.

questions.rawText: What types of content do you think are appropriate to post on social media?
questions.questionText: What types of content do you think are appropriate to post on social media?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, only positive, valuable and authentic content is appropriate to post on social media. First of all, uplifting daily life sharing is totally suitable. Posting ordinary but warm life moments creates a friendly online atmosphere and brings positive energy to viewers. In addition, knowledge-based content and practical tips are highly worthwhile. These posts help audiences acquire new skills and broaden their horizons. Besides, public welfare and helpful community information is also proper. Overall, we should always avoid extreme complaints or misleading rumors, and only publish positive and meaningful content online.

questions.rawText: What is one aspect of history that you find particularly interesting?
questions.questionText: What is one aspect of history that you find particularly interesting?
questions.referenceAnswer: I am particularly interested in the history of ordinary people's daily lives. Major wars and famous leaders are important, but details about food, housing, education, and family life make the past easier to imagine. They also show how social changes affected real individuals rather than only governments. Comparing an old household record with modern life often reveals both progress and traditions that have survived. That human perspective makes history meaningful to me.

questions.rawText: Describe a history-related activity or project you enjoyed, and what made it engaging?
questions.questionText: Describe a history-related activity or project you enjoyed, and what made it engaging?
questions.referenceAnswer: I enjoyed a group project in which we created a short podcast about a local historical street. We divided the work into archive research, interviews, writing, and audio editing. The most engaging part was comparing old photographs with the buildings that still exist today. Instead of memorizing isolated dates, we had to explain why the neighborhood changed. Producing something for real listeners made the research purposeful and helped the information stay in my memory.

questions.rawText: If you were to visit a historical site you’ve never visited before, which one would you choose and why?
questions.questionText: If you were to visit a historical site you’ve never visited before, which one would you choose and why?
questions.referenceAnswer: I would visit the ancient city of Xi'an, especially the Terracotta Army, because I have never seen such a large archaeological site in person. Photographs show the scale, but walking through the exhibition would make the craftsmanship and historical setting more concrete. I would also visit the city wall and a museum to connect military history with ordinary urban life. The trip would turn separate textbook facts into one vivid cultural experience.

questions.rawText: Do you think the study of history remains important in today’s educational system? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Do you think the study of history remains important in today’s educational system? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: History remains important because it gives students context for current events. Social conflicts, borders, and public institutions did not appear suddenly; they developed through earlier choices and consequences. Historical study also teaches students to compare sources and recognize bias instead of accepting a single simple story. Schools do not need to make students memorize endless dates, but they should use evidence and case studies to develop informed judgment.

questions.rawText: First, what kinds of hobbies do you think are especially popular today? Why do you think that is?
questions.questionText: First, what kinds of hobbies do you think are especially popular today? Why do you think that is?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, two kinds of hobbies stand out and become extremely popular among people nowadays. The first type is outdoor fitness activities such as jogging and hiking. The main reason is that modern citizens face heavy work pressure and long sedentary hours. These outdoor sports effectively ease physical discomfort and relieve mental anxiety. Besides, digital creative hobbies like short-video editing and hand-drawing are widely loved. That explains why these two categories of hobbies gain huge popularity in modern society.

questions.rawText: Next, what role do you think friends, family or community play in encouraging someone to take up a hobby?
questions.questionText: Next, what role do you think friends, family or community play in encouraging someone to take up a hobby?
questions.referenceAnswer: In my view, friends, family and the community play a vital and positive role in encouraging people to develop new hobbies. Firstly, family members provide the initial support and guidance. They offer resources and encouragement, helping people overcome difficulties when they try new hobbies for the first time. In addition, friends offer great companionship and motivation. Shared hobbies make learning more enjoyable and push individuals to keep practicing instead of giving up halfway. Finally, the community creates a supportive atmosphere. Overall, these external influences strongly motivate people to take up and stick to new hobbies.

questions.rawText: Now, many people start hobbies but don’t continue with them. What do you think leads people to give up on their hobbies?
questions.questionText: Now, many people start hobbies but don’t continue with them. What do you think leads people to give up on their hobbies?
questions.referenceAnswer: People often abandon hobbies because they underestimate the time and patience required. At the beginning, novelty creates strong motivation, but work or study soon competes for the same free time. Progress may also become slow once the basic stage is over, so beginners lose confidence. Setting a small weekly target and practicing with a friend can solve both problems. A hobby is more likely to last when expectations are realistic and improvement remains visible.

questions.rawText: Some people believe spending time on hobbies is essential, while others see it as a luxury. What is your opinion?
questions.questionText: Some people believe spending time on hobbies is essential, while others see it as a luxury. What is your opinion?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, pursuing hobbies is absolutely essential rather than a luxury in modern life. Admittedly, some people regard hobbies as a waste of time, because they are occupied with endless study and work. To them, hobbies seem like unnecessary extra entertainment. However, hobbies are actually indispensable. Firstly, they help people release pressure and relieve cumulative fatigue, maintaining stable mental well-being in fast-paced life. Furthermore, proper hobbies polish personal skills and refresh our minds. They improve our overall efficiency instead of distracting us. Therefore, hobbies are a vital necessity for a balanced life, not a luxury.

questions.rawText: Can you describe any benefits or disadvantages you might experience from using public transportation?
questions.questionText: Can you describe any benefits or disadvantages you might experience from using public transportation?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, public transportation brings both advantages and inconveniences. On one hand, it helps me cut travel costs effectively. Besides, subways and buses can avoid serious traffic jams and produce less pollution. On the other hand, there are obvious downsides. During rush hours, carriages are extremely crowded. Also, fixed routes mean I cannot travel as flexibly as driving a private car. Overall, it is a practical choice for daily short trips, yet it is not perfect for every travel need.

questions.rawText: Would you consider moving in order to have better access to public transportation? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Would you consider moving in order to have better access to public transportation? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: Yes, I would consider moving if the new place offered much better access to public transportation. Living close to a subway or major bus route would shorten my commute and make daily travel more predictable. It could also reduce my transportation costs because I would not need to drive or rely on taxis. However, I would still compare the rent, safety, and overall living environment before making a final decision. Better transportation would be an important factor, but not the only one.

questions.rawText: Some people believe that cities should invest more in public transportation to reduce traffic congestion, commuting time and pollution. Do you agree or disagree with this idea? Why?
questions.questionText: Some people believe that cities should invest more in public transportation to reduce traffic congestion, commuting time and pollution. Do you agree or disagree with this idea? Why?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, I fully agree that cities ought to invest more money in public transportation. Firstly, improved buses and subway networks encourage more residents to give up private cars. This effectively eases traffic congestion and cuts people’s daily commuting time. Furthermore, fewer private vehicles on roads mean lower exhaust emissions, which helps reduce urban pollution and improve air quality. Admittedly, large-scale infrastructure requires huge funding. Nevertheless, it brings lasting benefits to all citizens. Therefore, increased investment in public transit is a practical and worthwhile policy.

questions.rawText: How many hours do you sleep every day? Do you get enough sleep?
questions.questionText: How many hours do you sleep every day? Do you get enough sleep?
questions.referenceAnswer: Generally speaking, I sleep around seven hours every day. Honestly, I barely get enough sleep. I usually go to bed late and get up early for daily work. Seven hours of rest means I often feel sleepy in the afternoon, and it lowers my concentration. Occasionally, I try to go to bed earlier on weekends to make up for lost sleep. Therefore, I hope I can adjust my timetable to enjoy longer rest in the future。.

questions.rawText: What habits or daily arrangements can help improve sleep quality?
questions.questionText: What habits or daily arrangements can help improve sleep quality?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, several daily arrangements are helpful for better sleep quality. Firstly, people should stick to a fixed bedtime and wake-up time every day. This regular schedule stabilizes our biological clock. Besides, it is wise to reduce screen time one hour before going to bed and avoid coffee or strong tea at night. Blue light and caffeine will stop people from falling asleep easily. In addition, proper light exercise during the day also contributes to sound sleep. Overall, consistent small changes in daily routines greatly improve sleeping conditions.

questions.rawText: Do you prefer staying up late or getting up early?
questions.questionText: Do you prefer staying up late or getting up early?
questions.referenceAnswer: I prefer getting up early to staying up late. My concentration is stronger in the morning, so I can finish demanding work before messages and other distractions begin. An early schedule also encourages me to stop using screens at a reasonable time at night. I occasionally stay up for an urgent deadline, but doing that repeatedly leaves me tired and impatient the next day. A consistent early routine is more productive and healthier for me.

questions.rawText: Some people believe modern technology affects sleep quality. Do you agree?
questions.questionText: Some people believe modern technology affects sleep quality. Do you agree?
questions.referenceAnswer: From my perspective, I fully agree that modern technology has an influence on people’s sleep quality. Firstly, smartphones and laptops produce blue light. This kind of light suppresses melatonin production, making it harder for people to fall asleep after using devices before bed. Furthermore, interesting online videos and social media attract people to stay up late. Many people lose track of time and cut their sleeping hours short. Admittedly, technology itself is not bad. Nevertheless, improper use of digital products greatly disturbs regular rest. Therefore, modern technology can easily damage our sleep quality without self-control.

questions.rawText: Do you like giving gifts? Why or why not?
questions.questionText: Do you like giving gifts? Why or why not?
questions.referenceAnswer: Personally, I really like giving gifts to my family and close friends. First of all, I take great pleasure in choosing suitable presents. I always take time to consider their preferences, so gift-giving becomes meaningful instead of casual shopping. Besides, I gain a strong sense of satisfaction when I see their surprise and joy. Gifts are a wonderful way to convey care and affection for people I value. All in all, that is why I enjoy giving gifts so much.

questions.rawText: How do you decide what gifts to give? What factors do you take into consideration?
questions.questionText: How do you decide what gifts to give? What factors do you take into consideration?
questions.referenceAnswer: Personally, I consider several important things before choosing gifts for others. To begin with, I focus on the receiver’s hobbies and real daily needs. I try to pick items they can actually use, rather than something fancy but impractical. Apart from that, I always take my budget into consideration. I do not chase expensive goods blindly. It is the thought instead of the price that matters most. In short, combining people’s interests, practical needs and proper budget helps me decide on ideal gifts.

questions.rawText: Describe a memorable gift you have either given or received.
questions.questionText: Describe a memorable gift you have either given or received.
questions.referenceAnswer: I’d like to talk about a memorable gift I received from my best friend. It was a travel notebook she gave me on my birthday. Firstly, she knew I loved travelling and writing down my experiences. She even wrote some warm wishes on the first page. What’s more, this notebook holds special value for me. Every time I open it, it reminds me of our friendship and the happy time we spent together. Overall, it is not expensive, but full of sincere thought. That is why this gift stays so memorable for me.

questions.rawText: When you receive gifts, do you prefer gifts from your wish list or surprise gifts? Which one do you like better?
questions.questionText: When you receive gifts, do you prefer gifts from your wish list or surprise gifts? Which one do you like better?
questions.referenceAnswer: Personally, I prefer surprise gifts rather than items from a wish list. To start with, surprise gifts bring a special feeling of excitement. The curiosity before opening the package is really enjoyable, while gifts from a wish list have no sense of anticipation. Besides, a wonderful surprise usually means the giver carefully notices my hobbies and daily needs. It shows sincere attention from others. Although wish-list gifts seldom go wrong, they lack such emotional fun. All in all, unexpected surprise gifts appeal to me much more.
